database.name: AISC shapes (compiled, unverified)
database.description: American structural shapes compiled from the AISC Shapes Database v16.0 as published in the steelpy package 1.1.1. Written in inches and pounds per foot; StructureGen converts on load.
database.notes: NOT VERIFIED. Every record carries "verified": false and names its source. The numbers were compiled mechanically by tools/data-sources/compile_sections.py from a third party transcription of AISC's database, not from AISC's own file, and no fillet radius is published by AISC - the value here is reconstructed from the tabulated design distance k. Verify against your own authoritative source before using any output from this dataset for procurement or fabrication.
